title: Counterattack in Desperation
next_chapter_hook: The pursuing forces were annihilated, yet from the remnants of memory fragments, Chen Ji glimpsed a truth that sent a chill down his spine—the布局 of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets ran far deeper and earlier than he had ever imagined.

text.content: The numbers on the Tianji Record Fragment pulsed like death warrants—three hours, the countdown begins. Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul left him with one final cryptic remark: "The method to break the局 lies not within the formation, but within the one who set it." Chen Ji stared at the ink that was about to burn out, yet a smile actually curved his lips. "The heart of the one who set the局?" he murmured softly, his fingertips tapping lightly on the fragment. "Old man, are you telling me this battle requires calculation with the heart, or gambling with the heart?"

dialogue.content: Fine, whether it's calculation or gambling. Three hours is enough for me to stage one hell of a show.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and activated the Tianji Record Fragment. Images flooded into his mind like a tide—the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' pursuers, thirty-three in total, led by a black-robed executor in the late Golden Core stage, all elites among elites. In a direct confrontation, he wouldn't survive even half a stick of incense. But the Tianji Record revealed not only the enemy's strength, but also their arrival time, marching route, and even how many cracks remained on that executor's communication jade pendant at his waist. "I see it." Chen Ji opened his eyes, a flash of brilliant light vanishing in the depths of his pupils. "In three hours, they'll catch up to me at Blue Stone Valley."

dialogue.content: Blue Stone Valley? That place is surrounded by mountains on three sides with a natural spiritual formation base at its center—quite a good location for setting formations. However, Chen Ji, do you plan to fight thirty-three Golden Core cultivators single-handedly?

text.content: Ye Qing's figure emerged from the shadows. The Demonic Path Saintess was shrouded in a faint purple mist, her unique "Demonic Path Mist" that could mask the probing aura of the Tianji Record. At this moment, her expression was unusually grave, clearly startled by Chen Ji's insane plan as well. Yet Chen Ji merely smiled, tucking the Tianji Record Fragment into his sleeve: "Who said I'm going to fight them single-handedly?" His gaze swept toward the distant mountain ridges. "When inviting a guest into a jar, one must have someone to do the inviting."

dialogue.content: Are you insane?! How much Heavenly Fate do you have left? Every use of the Tianji Record consumes five points—are you not dying fast enough?

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer her interrogation. He rose slowly, his gaze sweeping over the rolling peaks of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, his voice terrifyingly calm: "Ye Qing, how large an area can your Demonic Path Mist conceal the spiritual fluctuations?" Ye Qing froze slightly, apparently not expecting such a direct question. After a moment of contemplation, she said: "If concealing only one person's aura, at most half an hour." Chen Ji nodded: "That's enough." He raised his hand, and a stack of talisman papers already prepared flew out from his sleeve. "You're responsible for setting up the mist barrier at the outer perimeter of Blue Stone Valley, blocking their perceptual-type artifacts. I'll give you two hours."

I'll lure them here. Thirty-three Golden Core elites—the Eye of Heavenly Secrets really spared no expense to kill me." Chen Ji brushed the dust off his robes, a mocking curve playing at his lips. "Since they so desperately want to see me dead, let them witness how atrash turns the tables and kills them first." Ye Qing stared at him for a long while before finally sighing softly: "You're the leasttrash-liketrash I've ever seen." Chen Ji smiled indifferently: "Mutual."

choice.prompt: With the three-hour countdown pressing, Chen Ji must decide how to lure the pursuers into the trap. This is the crucial step that determines the overall situation.

choices.text: Use oneself as bait, provoke openly
choices.description: Actively expose one's aura, appear brazenly in the pursuers' line of sight,激怒 them into pursuit with an arrogant posture. Extremely high risk, but ensures all pursuers take the bait.
choices.visible_reward: Pursuers will definitely pursue with full force, formation difficult to maintain
choices.risk_hint: If cornered, Tianji Record consumption will be hard to control

text.content: Two hours later, thirty li outside Blue Stone Valley. Chen Ji deliberately slowed his pace, making his aura as conspicuous as a bonfire in the darkness. He knew the pursuers had locked onto his position. Behind him, faint spiritual fluctuations came from the distant forest—at least a dozen auras were rapidly approaching. "They're here." He murmured to himself, yet his steps did not stop; instead, he deliberately stomped heavier, leaving a clear trail of footprints in the snow.

choices.text: Combine the real and the illusory, draw the enemy in deep
choices.description: Leave multiple false aura traces along the route to mislead the pursuers' judgments, while setting misleading traps before truly entering Blue Stone Valley. Medium risk, but may be identified.
choices.visible_cost: Setting false traces takes considerable time
choices.visible_reward: Pursuers will definitely scatter upon entering Blue Stone Valley, facilitating defeat in detail
choices.risk_hint: If among the pursuers there are perceptual-type experts, they may see through the layout

text.content: Chen Ji pushed the Tianji Record to its limit, repeatedly deducing the pursuers' possible routes in his mind. While traveling swiftly, he left cloth scraps and blood-stained clothing corners at key nodes along the route. These traces seemed chaotic but actually contained hidden intricacies—they would guide the pursuers onto a seemingly shortest pursuit route, and that route's end was precisely the death entrance of Blue Stone Valley. "They'll think they're the hunters." Chen Ji murmured. "Unaware they're the prey."

choices.text: Borrow a knife to kill, let the enemy destroy themselves
choices.description: Exploit possible conflicts within the pursuer ranks, spread rumors or create misunderstandings causing internal conflict among them. Lowest risk, but most time-consuming, may not have enough time to complete the Five-Layered Lethal Formation.
choices.visible_reward: Pursuers will have been halved by the time they enter Blue Stone Valley
choices.risk_hint: Three-hour countdown may not be sufficient

text.content: Chen Ji activated the Tianji Record, his gaze piercing through time and space, glimpsing a subtle crack within the pursuer ranks—a certain unspoken grudge between the black-robed executor and a silver-armored deputy officer. He slightly curved his lips, then deliberately dropped a pre-prepared "secret letter" at a place the pursuers were certain to pass. The letter read: "The executor has decided to eliminate all of you at Blue Stone Valley to claim the credit alone." This was of course false, but Chen Ji understood the human heart well—when death approaches, people would rather believe rumors than verify the truth.

Regardless of which strategy Chen Ji chose, three hours later, he appeared precisely at the entrance of Blue Stone Valley. Behind him, dust rose, thirty-three powerful auras surged forward like a tide. The black-robed executor coldly laughed: "Chen Ji, you were running? Why the hurry?" Chen Ji slowly turned around, the terror on his face恰到好处—that was the despair of someone cornered with nowhere to hide. His gaze swept across the faces of the pursuers, imprinting each person's expression into his mind. "Run?" he said softly. "Why would I run?"

dialogue.content: The scenery here is beautiful, the feng shui excellent—what better place to serve as your burial ground?

text.content: The black-robed executor froze for a moment, then burst into laughter toward the sky: "Burial ground? As a Foundation Buildingtrash, you dare—" Before he finished, his laughter stopped abruptly. Because he saw the first formation rune light up on the ground beneath Chen Ji's feet. Then the second, third, fourth, fifth. Five-Layered Lethal Formation, all activated in the same instant! Violent spiritual energy swept through like a tsunami, and the faces of all thirty-three Golden Core cultivators instantly turned ashen. "H-How is this possible..." The black-robed executor's voice trembled. "When did you set up this formation!"

choice.prompt: Five-Layered Lethal Formation fully activated, pursuers trapped in despair! Chen Ji must decide the next move—full annihilation, or does he have other plans?

choices.text: Annihilate with full force, leave no survivors
choices.description: Activate the formation's core, let the formation operate at full capacity, grinding all enemies to powder in the shortest time. Clean and decisive, but may miss intelligence.
choices.visible_reward: Instant total annihilation of enemies, no future worries
choices.risk_hint: May miss important intelligence carried by enemies

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate in the slightest. He formed seals with both hands, spiritual energy flooding madly into the formation's eye. The Five-Layered Lethal Formation roared to life—celestial thunder, earthly fire, toxic miasma, glacial frost, sword intent—five world-destroying forces intertwined within the formation into a symphony of death. Screams rang out one after another, thirty-three Golden Core cultivators struggling, collapsing, turning to ash within the formation. The black-robed executor fought with all his might to break through, yet a sword intent pierced through his chest, pinning him to the formation wall. "You... how is this possible..." He stared fixedly at Chen Ji, eyes filled with utter disbelief. "You明明只是个trash...!"

choices.text: Leave one survivor, read their memories
choices.description: Spare the black-robed executor's life, use secret arts to read his memories and obtain more core intelligence about the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. Risk lies in the survivor possibly committing suicide or being eliminated by companions.
choices.visible_cost: Need to split attention controlling the survivor
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence to support subsequent plans
choices.risk_hint: Survivor may self-destruct memories or be eliminated remotely

text.content: Chen Ji's fingertip flicked, and the formation abruptly contracted. The black-robed executor collapsed to the ground, drenched in blood, yet still clinging to his last breath. "What... what do you want..." His voice was hoarse, a flash of fear in his eyes. Chen Ji walked slowly to his side, looking down at him from above: "I want to know what's inside your head." He squatted down, pressing one finger to the executor's brow center, and the power of the Tianji Record quietly surged. In an instant, countless images flashed by like a carousel—the organizational structure of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, the deeper conspiracy, and a name that made Chen Ji's pupils suddenly constrict.

Just then, a clear cry suddenly resounded through the sky. A green sword light slashed through the void, aiming directly for Chen Ji's heart! "Chen Ji, watch out!" A familiar voice rang out as Su Qingyao's figure swept in from the side, her sword drawn, barely deflecting that sword light. However, in the next second, a figure hidden in the shadows suddenly struck, a palm thrust toward Su Qingyao's back—a silver-armored deputy officer who had been concealing his aura all along, finally revealing his fangs!

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! Don't worry about me, kill the executor first!

text.content: Yet Chen Ji's reaction was faster than hers. He didn't even turn around, merely raising his hand lightly. A talisman already prepared in his sleeve silently flew out. The talisman exploded in mid-air, transforming into a golden chain that precisely wrapped around the silver-armored deputy officer's neck. "I told you," Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "This person remembers grudges the most." He slowly turned his head, gazing at that face contorted from strangulation. "That palm just now, I'm returning it for Qingyao."

dialogue.content: Also, whoever among you was turned by Su Qingyao, you may act now.

text.content: The moment those words fell, seven people within the formation simultaneously erupted! Taking advantage of their companions being critically wounded by the lethal formation and the chaotic spiritual energy within, they decisively turned on their own people! Amidst the flashing blades and swords, another dozen Golden Core cultivators fell. The black-robed executor's eyes nearly burst from their sockets: "You... you traitors!" A middle-aged cultivator wiped the blood from his face, coldly smiling: "Executor, we were always people of Chief Su. This mission was a死局 from the start—did you really think the Eye of Heavenly Secrets would let us live to return?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, my people have secured the outer perimeter. Next—

text.content: Before Su Qingyao could finish, the sky suddenly darkened. A terrifying, suffocating might descended from the heavens, and Chen Ji's expression instantly changed drastically—that was an aura of the Nascent Soul stage! Impossible! Intelligence clearly stated the pursuers were only Golden Core stage! His Tianji Record spun at maximum speed, but in the next second, it captured a scene that made his spine crawl: at the distant horizon, a figure was walking through the void. That person's face was hidden within black mist, but those eyes—those eyes filled with cold detachment and lofty superiority, instantly made Chen Ji understand something.

dialogue.content: The Eye of Heavenly Secrets... personally intervened?

text.content: Just as that Nascent Soul pressure was about to envelop the entire Blue Stone Valley, a crisp and familiar voice rang out in Chen Ji's mind: "Brother, I can interfere with his perception, but you only have three breaths of time." It was Chen Nian! Chen Jiabruptly turned, only to see at the depths of the valley, two figures stood hand in hand—Chen Nian and Chen Ling, their brow centers simultaneously lit with blinding light, the power of the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key"! The enemy's perceptual-type artifacts instantly malfunctioned, and even that Nascent Soul expert walking through the void hesitated mid-air, as if having lost his target.

Chen Ji shouted sternly, his hands abruptly pressing together. The formation's core was completely detonated, violent spiritual energy erupting a world-destroying storm within the formation! Those pursuers still struggling didn't even have time to scream before being ground to powder. The black-robed executor's body disintegrated amid the sword intent, his final gaze toward Chen Ji filled with reluctance and fear. Chen Ji stood at the storm's center, robes fluttering, yet his eyes were a terrifying calm. Three breaths passed in an instant. When Chen Nian and Chen Ling's power was exhausted and both collapsed to the ground, not a single living enemy remained in Blue Stone Valley.

That Nascent Soul expert walking through the void hovered in mid-air, silent for a long while. Finally, he turned and vanished into the void, as if he had never appeared. Chen Ji knew this was not the enemy letting him off, but that the enemy had something more important to do. This battle, he won. But the victory was hard-won. "Brother..." Chen Nian's weak voice came, and Chen Ji strode forward, pulling his sister into his embrace. Su Qingyao also walked over, her gaze complex as it fell on Chen Ji, seemingly wanting to say something, yet not knowing where to begin. Ye Qing's figure emerged from the shadows; she glanced at the corpses littering the ground and at Chen Ji standing in the blood pool, then suddenly said softly: "I'm starting to believe you can survive to the end."

Chen Ji did not heed their sentiments. He walked to where the black-robed executor's remains lay, retrieving a blood-stained jade pendant from his waist. It was a communication token from within the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. Though shattered, the memory fragments within had not yet completely dissipated. Chen Ji pressed the jade pendant to his brow center, and the power of the Tianji Record surged once more. This time, the images he saw were far clearer than before—a massive plan, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets was arranging a chess game spanning three hundred years. And he, Chen Ji, was merely a piece on the board. But even pieces have their uses. "Interesting." Chen Ji murmured softly, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his lips. "Since you want to use me as a piece, let's see in the end who devours whom."
